reading_note: The teaching traces the entire arc of redemption as a sequence of prayer-and-answer: divine truth (First Man) descends into the realm of self-love to guard the boundary, becomes entangled in temptation and falsity, cries out from the depths; the matrix of spiritual affection (Mother of Life) intercedes with the Divine itself (Father); the Father answers by sending the Living Spirit — the operative rational power that lifts truth back out of bondage and establishes the ordered structure of the regenerate mind (cosmos, firmaments, wheels). Then a second prayer is made for the trapped good of life (Living Soul) still mingled in the natural; the Ambassador/Third Messenger comes forth in mercy to separate her from the fleshes of death and set her in rest. Finally Jesus the Splendour, third in the series, perfects the purpose-of-heart of the elements and consummates the freeing of the soul. The single arc: prayer from distress → answering influx → rescue → ordered building → consummation in the Beloved.
